objects.description: [Vidar](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9050) has used the function `CryptDecrypt`. Additionally, [Vidar](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9050) has decoded the .data section using bitwise XOR operations.(Citation: Cyfirma_Vidar_June2024) [Vidar](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9050) has decoded its core code after confirming debugger and/or analysis tools.(Citation: Cyfirma_Vidar_June2024)
